title: DOMAIN-INGRESS — PICO direct M3 calculation-data import
summary: Explore of the PICO direct (domain-ingress) handler inside the price Functions container: ~23 M3 *Changed contracts arriving on q:price-domain-ingress are imported as price-calculation data into the price database. Which ingress path is live (ADF CSV vs ASB/PICO) is an unresolved documented conflict.

sources.note: price.fn.domain-ingress handler (q:price-domain-ingress) in container func-app; injected by ext:m3-pico.
Lines 63–228: DOMAIN (PICO direct) subjects: ~23 M3 *Changed contracts.

Product/design intent: DSP Price subscribes to M3 key tables and provides price simulation outside M3 (avoids OIS320MI cost/limits); for ecommerce + customer price list tools. Campaign special case CMNO→CSYTAB. Not deployment proof.
Design intent: replace ADF CSV ingress with PICO/Table Event streams (OnPrem M3 then M3 Cloud); Ingress SQL on same instance as domain; minimal ingress storage. Not deployment proof.

Historical 2021 overview: ADF nightly CSV dump → blob trigger → Function → SQL; Web API via APIM/Okta; names web-870-*/func-870-*/sql; ASB messages n/a. Design intent / historical ops — not proof of current topology.

uncertainties: dsp-price copy has no .git; evidence identified by per-file sha256 (Team Lead ruled HEAD check unnecessary).
Per-handler internals of ~23 PICO and 14 command subjects are grouped, not enumerated.
Write-side storage type/topology beyond EF registration is not asserted.

Unresolved conflict: Confluence 22774388 v2 describes ADF nightly CSV ingress and ASB messages as n/a, while registration + PICO design (22773861 v67) and current handlers imply ASB queues/PICO — which path is live is unresolved; do not invent.
Re-cut from retired root layer:price.func-app (ADDENDA-011.1 per-handler roots); old layer id is ignored for dsp-arch-pos and not recycled. New split layers start auto-layout.
Responsibilities of sibling handlers in the same container are shown only as boundary queue/store nodes; no cross-root edges are drawn.
